function.name: lookup_customer
function.description: Look up a fictional Summit Air demo customer using the callback phone number the caller provided and confirmed. A match is not identity verification. Supply full_name when known, especially to disambiguate a shared number.

phone_number.description: Caller-confirmed US or Canadian callback number, ideally +1 followed by ten digits.

full_name.description: Full name provided by the caller. Never guess.
